diagram_math_checks.objects_and_domains: A,B,C are ordered Q_2 registers; the input vector is |psi>_A tensor |Phi+>_BC. Bell supplier defines |Phi+>=(|00>+|11>)/sqrt(2); the resource box has B and C output wires and is not a preparation operation.

diagram_math_checks.gates_and_order: The CNOT dot on top A and circled plus on B implement |a,t> -> |a,t xor a>; H acts on A afterwards, with C untouched. CNOT is an endomorphism of Q_2 tensor Q_2, H an endomorphism of Q_2; their embeddings act on the ordered three-register product.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Assigned Definition step 1; def-qc-cnot-and-control-target-order Definition; exact Hadamard matrix in def-qc-one-qubit-gate-alphabet-and-rotations.

diagram_math_checks.measurement_and_classical_edges: The top M_Z records a from A; the middle M_Z records b from B. The two dashed arrows originate at distinct measurements and end on Z^a and X^b respectively, with no quantum connection from Alice to C. The caption defines M_Z as computational-basis measurement, not a coherent control gate.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Assigned Definition steps 2–3; finite measurement/classical suffix convention in def-qc-classical-control-and-measurement-circuit.

diagram_math_checks.correction_relation: C runs left-to-right through X^b then Z^a, so its suffix is Z^a X^b as an endomorphism of Q_2. In particular the a=b=1 branch has uncorrected XZ|psi>; ZX(XZ)|psi>=|psi>, with no extra sign.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Assigned Definition step 4; explicit X and Z matrices in def-qc-pauli-matrices. Independent amplitude calculation applied CNOT then H to each of |0>_A and |1>_A tensored with Phi+ and checked all four outcomes after corrections: every unnormalized corrected branch equals one-half the input basis vector (absolute numerical error below 1e-12). Linearity gives the stated convention for arbitrary input.
